description.value: No Frills is a Canadian discount supermarket chain owned by Loblaws, known for no-frills pricing and a wide selection of everyday groceries under the PC and no name brands. The 310 West Broadway location sits in a two-storey retail building in Vancouver's Broadway corridor, convenient for cyclists passing through the area. It accepts cash and debit and is air-conditioned, making it a practical resupply stop on a city ride or touring route.
